*In the current source (v0.28.0, not released yet): a creature of [the Underhearth](/world/underhearth/#creatures)’s Cinder Wastes, a tier 5 land.*

A Charger of the Cinder Wastes grown over with slag. It headbutts, stomps and charges like a Charger, but faster and harder, and the ground it tears up during a charge is left **burning** for 5 seconds (standing in it sets the hero alight). Bait the charge into an obstacle to stun it, and stay out of its trail. It does not burn.

Its numbers are the Charger’s: ×1.7 health, ×1.6 poise, ×1.4 damage and ×1.15 speed.

## Health and poise

| Level | Variant | Easy / Builder health | Normal health | Hard / Hardcore health | Poise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Slagback | 195.5 | 215.05 | 254.15 | 104 |
| 2 | Slagback | 283.47 | 311.82 | 368.52 | 104 |
| 3 | Slagback Elder | 371.45 | 408.6 | 482.88 | 104 |

These are non-elite values before omens. Poise does not scale with creature level or difficulty. Creatures born in the outer lands are stronger by their land's danger tier (since v0.27.0): Birchwood and the coast **×1.35 health** and **×1.25 damage**, Elderwood and the Mire **×1.65** and **×1.45**, the Highlands and the Skerries **×1.9** and **×1.65**, with more poise, keener senses, a little more speed and elites more often; packs of Stalkers and spiders there hold one more. See [the lands' tiers](/biomes/). Base movement speed: **4.14 m/s**, before night, state, omen and elite modifiers.

## Attacks

| Attack | Base damage | Normal, level 1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Headbutt | 22.4 | 25.09 |
| Charge | 33.6 | 37.63 |
| Stomp | 19.6 | 21.95 |

Damage = base × (1 + 0.3 × (level − 1)) × difficulty multiplier. Easy/Builder: ×1; Normal: ×1.12; Hard/Hardcore: ×1.35. This is outgoing hit damage before the hero’s armour, mitigation and other combat effects. Venom and grave rot are separate status effects.

## Damage types

| Kind of blow | Damage taken | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Crushing (clubs, fists) | ×1.5 | Weak |
| Cutting (blades, axes) | ×0.7 | Resists |
| Piercing (spears, arrows, picks) | ×0.7 | Resists |

A blow on a creature that has not noticed anyone is a **sneak attack**: ×3 damage, at most once every 5 minutes per creature. Exposed creatures take ×1.6 on top. See [Sneaking and damage types](/mechanics/#sneaking-and-damage-types).

## Elite and warden modifiers

Elite health is multiplied by 1.6, poise by 1.3 and outgoing damage by 1.15. Ironhide adds ×1.8 health and ×1.6 poise; Frenzied adds ×1.35 damage; Swift adds ×1.3 movement speed. Barrow wardens also apply their own health multiplier, ×1.6 poise and ×1.2 damage. These effects stack.

Elite loot is **additional** to the normal drops: one <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/slagback-trophy/"><img src="/images/icons/slagbacktrophy.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Slagback Trophy</a>, two <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/hide/"><img src="/images/icons/hide.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Raw Hide</a>, plus one <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/crystal/"><img src="/images/icons/crystal.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Echo Crystal</a> with 65% / 80% / 95% chance at level 1 / 2 / 3. The game uses the Stalker trophy for elite spiders too. Omens can add further drops.
